text: Yara - lives in Leith now, works @ the uni library. sister Dalia in Glasgow.
Obi + Imani expecting!! due early March. 2nd one. Obi says Imani's knackered, morning sickness bad. text her sometime next week
flat viewing w/ Rachel Sat at 11 - Hackney, 2 bed. she's nervous re rent
Akira moving to Osaka end of the month - job transfer @ Sony. ask re leaving drinks date
Adebayo = Ade. brother of Kofi. accountant, works from home mostly
Amy's baby arrived!! girl, 3.2kg, born Tues at 4am. name tbc. send flowers to her + Andre
christening for little Rohan - Sun 14th at half 10, St Mary's. Julien is godfather. need to sort a gift - silver something?
Ethan - got the keys to new place in Bristol Fri. moving in over the weekend. his dog Biscuit hates the van lol
Asha's mum lives w/ them now. Aarav works nights @ the hospital, A&E.
Aidan / Kofi - flatshare in Peckham. Kofi teaches yr 6, Aidan does something in insurance
Adriana pregnant - 12wk scan tomorrow morning. v anxious after last time. don't forget to message her after
bins Thurs. pick up parcel from depot before 6

Aneesh Kumar - landlord selling, has to be out by end of Nov. looking at places in Croydon / Thornton Heath, struggling to find anything under 1400 that isn't grim. his wife works in Sutton so can't go far. 2 viewings booked Thurs evening after work. sounded properly fed up on the phone. check in w/ him next wk, maybe send him the Rightmove link Idris used
Idris + Moira house hunting. viewing in Chorlton Wed at 5:30, another sometime next week. Moira really wants a garden
Kaito - wife Hiroshi? no, wife is Anika. Hiroshi is his dad, lives in Kyoto

Katarzyna (Kasia) due any day now - officially the 3rd but midwife thinks sooner. her mum flying in from Krakow Mon morning, staying a month. husband Stefan has bag packed in the car since last wk lol. she's done w/ being pregnant, can't sleep, feet swollen. must ring her once baby's here, and drop off the cot sheets I promised
Nasser's sister had twins last wk!! boys. he's an uncle x2 now. congrats card
Imani - works @ BBC Salford, producer. vegetarian. lives in Didsbury w/ partner Stefan
Isaac moved to Leeds in the summer, says he's lonely, doesn't know anyone yet. invite him down for a wknd sometime in Dec
Matilda's housewarming Sat 8pm. bring wine. new flat is above the bakery on Mill Rd
Kenji + wife moving back to Tokyo early spring. kids starting school there in April
Hoang Le - Rachel's cousin. lives in Manchester, runs a pho place in the northern quarter. mentioned he's opening 2nd site over the summer
Dalia - 20wk scan was fine, it's a boy. she's buying everything in green. gift idea: those muslin wraps she liked
call Yara re: christening - is it the 2nd or 9th? she said 'morning service' either way

Obi's mum - in hospital w/ hip. op Thurs at 2pm. Obi stressed, juggling that + new baby coming in a few wks + work pushing him on a deadline. Imani can't drive to the hospital at this stage so it's all on him. his brother Andre is flying back from Lisbon sometime next week to help. text him Thurs eve, offer to do a hospital run Sat
Rachel - didn't get the flat in Hackney. gutted. 2 more viewings Fri at 3pm and Sat morning
Andre = Dre. works @ Deliveroo HQ, product. grew up in Lisbon. mum still there
Akira's leaving do cancelled - moved to Zoom instead, Thurs 7pm ish

Adebayo + wife Funmi - baby christening sometime in Jan, prob the 2nd or 3rd Sunday, at their church in Lewisham. he asked if I'd be godparent!! didn't say much in the moment, was a bit stunned. need to say yes properly - call him tomorrow evening. find out what godparents actually do. also Funmi's parents coming over from Lagos for it
Amy - back home w/ baby, sleeping terribly. Andre off on paternity for 2wks. drop round a lasagne sometime this wk, maybe Wed afternoon
me - viewing at 14 Elm Grove tomorrow at 9. bring payslips + ID
Rohan Shah - Asha's brother. dentist in Leicester. 2 kids, Mira + Dev. lives near his in-laws
Julien moved to Lyon last month for the new role. sounded happy, flat tiny tho. ask how settling in, end of the month maybe
Ethan's partner Aidan expecting? no - Aidan's SISTER is expecting. due late Feb. Ethan v excited to be an uncle

Asha - 3rd trimester, back pain, signed off work early. Aarav doing everything at home and also fixing up the nursery, still not painted. baby shower Sat 22nd at 2 at her sister Moira's in Harrow. bring something for the hamper - she hinted at a nice dressing gown, the waffle kind. she's also v into true crime podcasts rn
Aarav - new job @ Barclays from Mon. moving to Canary Wharf flat end of next month. good luck msg sunday night
Kofi's girlfriend Yara - nurse, St Thomas'. originally from Beirut. they met at uni
Adriana - scan all fine!! due mid May. she cried. she's told her parents but not work yet

Idris got the Chorlton place!! offer accepted Fri afternoon after a bidding war. completion probably early Jan, survey sometime next week. Moira already picking paint and arguing about a dog. they'll be selling the Levenshulme flat over the summer, no rush. congratulate them both, maybe a plant for the new place. Idris's brother Isaac is doing the move w/ a van
Moira's dad - retired, lives in Inverness, widower. she visits every summer
Kaito + Anika - baby boy born Sun night, Haruto. both fine. Kaito's dad Hiroshi flying over sometime next week to meet him
Katarzyna - baby Zofia here!! born Wed at 11:40pm after 30hr labour. Kasia exhausted but ok. her mum staying till mid Dec. ring her this weekend, not before
Hiroshi - Kaito says he's v into bonsai, has like 40 trees. possible gift if ever needed
Anika - works part time @ a design studio in Shoreditch. allergic to nuts. cat called Miso
Nasser moving to Dubai?? only 'maybe' - job offer, deciding by end of the month. wife not keen. ask him over coffee what he decided

Imani + Stefan - moving out of Didsbury to Sale, bigger place for when baby comes (due Apr). viewing Sat at 10, then second one Sunday morning. Stefan's doing all the spreadsheets, school catchments, commute times etc. Imani worried about the stairs w/ a bump. her mum lives in Sale already so that's the main draw. ask how viewings went Mon
Isaac - mentioned his brother Aneesh? no, brother is Aidan Brennan. works in Leeds too, in IT. that's partly why he moved
Stefan - German, from Hamburg. engineer @ Siemens. runs marathons

Matilda - pregnant!! told us at the housewarming. due late spring, prob early June. her partner Kenji over the moon, kept hugging everyone. she had a rough first trimester, still v tired, off wine obviously. 12wk scan was Tues. don't say anything yet - only us + her mum know. hints: she wants one of those big pregnancy pillows
Kenji's mum - Mrs Kim - had a fall last wk, broke wrist. Kenji driving up to Durham Fri morning to help her move into sheltered housing. text him Fri night
Hoang - his wife Dalia's baby shower moved to Sunday at 1. he wants a surprise - collect from everyone by Thurs
Dalia + Hoang - baby christening cancelled, doing a naming day in the garden instead, sometime in the summer
rent due 1st. book van for the 15th, morning slot. cancel broadband before move
Yara + Kofi - engaged? no just moving in together, Brixton flat, from the 1st. she's bringing the cat, Pepper. housewarming tbc

Obi - baby boy born Sat at 6am!! Chidi, 3.6kg. Imani recovering, emergency c-section, in for a couple more nights. Obi on paternity till mid Nov. his mum still on crutches after the hip so can't help much. send hamper to their place + text Obi this evening. also ask Kofi if he's chipping in, and sort a visit for end of next week if they're up for it
Rachel finally signed for flat - Walthamstow, 1 bed, moving in sometime next week. her sister Amy helping. Rachel nervous about living alone first time
Akira - settled in Osaka, apartment near Namba. his girlfriend Yara (diff Yara) joining him over the summer. said call him Sunday at 9am my time, evening his

Adebayo's daughter Amara starting nursery in Jan. they're moving to Walthamstow end of Dec to be near the good one, exchange early next month. Funmi due again in early March too, and Adebayo just started a new role at work. lot going on - he looked wiped. should check in w/ him sometime next week, maybe Weds lunchtime
Andre - grew up Lisbon, lives Camden now, works Deliveroo. Amy says he's a huge Benfica fan. 30th bday next summer, could do match tickets
Aneesh found a flat! Croydon, 2 bed, moving the 28th at half 8. his mum's coming down from Leicester to help. I'm driving the van that morning. ask how the 1st night went
